sections.title: Concepts

sections.summary: The ASMs are stored in json files. The location does not matter, but they are usually placed in an asms folder.

sections.title: Transitions
sections.summary: The transitions section defines which states can go to what other states. A state can go to 0, 1, or many other states. To define a state as going to no other states, omit it from the section.

sections.title: Blocks

sections.title: Items

sections.title: Entities

sections.title: Filesystem Structure Conventions
